'''Karen Dochek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] trainer who resided on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. She trained a [[Hunter (individual)|certain bounty hunter]] known as the "[[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]."

==Behind the scenes==
Karin Dochek appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a trainer for the bounty hunter class on Taris.
